prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: says I'm on "standby" but I bought a ticket. Should I be concerned? #help
Delta: You're on standby for a seat assignment, no need to worry. *AJY

Customer: why wasnt I given the seat I selected when i bought my ticket. 29a was nOt what I selected. T#0062397073524
Delta: was assigned once you booked your reservation.  *HEC

Customer: i bought ticket from Yyz to sju but has overnight stop over in atl ...do I have to pay baggage once or twice? #question
Delta: To give you the most accurate information, can you please DM your confirmation number? *TBW https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: How is it that I bought my ticket 2 months ago and checked in 24hrs in advance on the dot and I’m still in the last boarding group 🙄🙄🙄
Delta: You can find more information regarding your Boarding Zone on the following link:  https://t.co/5G1OCcLO1S. Please, let us know if you still have any questions. *AMV

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: website_app_issue):
"""I bought a ticket with trip protection last night, but the system erred and did not add it. It gave a phone number to call"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Sorry for the trouble! Please DM us your confirmation number so we can look into the trip‑protection issue. *
